subject: Starlight — leadership recap & decision anchors (procurement + escalation checklist)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@starlight.io>, Alex Wong <awong@starlight.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starlight — leadership recap & decision anchors (procurement + escalation checklist)

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from my side so the leadership team has the decision anchors and procurement path documented. I kept this tight so you can forward to the CFO/Procurement.

Top pain & objectives we heard
- Cost predictability at scale: burst monthly spikes in encoding/embedding costs are causing budget volatility.
- Low-latency inference for customer-facing features (p50 < 120ms) to avoid UX regressions.
- Data isolation / audit trail for compliance (should be covered by a Private deployment).

Business outcomes Starlight is prioritizing
1) Launch personalization pilot (100k monthly queries) with <200ms median latency, measurable CTR lift within Q3.
2) Maintain token spend budget guidance and get a committed-capacity quote for predictable monthly billing.
3) Ensure SOC2-aligned evidence and audit logs for the pilot.

Risk / procurement constraints you flagged
- Procurement requires a single-vendor SOW with explicit SLAs and a vendor risk questionnaire filled out by next week.
- Finance will not approve >30% initial spend until an internal pilot ROI is demonstrated.

Next steps (owners + dates)
- Redwood: Send a short pilot proposal + SOW draft and a filled MOP (answers to your questionnaire) by EOD Monday — owner: Jonas (attached).
- Starlight: Share procurement contact info and an estimate of expected peak Q3 token volume by Tuesday — owner: Priya.
- Redwood: Provide a commitment lane (3-month pilot reserved capacity) pricing and an optional small credit for launch risk — owner: Karthik, deliver by Wednesday.

Escalation checklist (if procurement stalls)
- If procurement needs an exec-level call, Jonas to schedule a 15-min call with Redwood VP of Sales and your CFO.
- Consider a limited-duration credit and revenue share metric to bridge the approval gap.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf (pilot scope + SOW draft), starlight-mop-answers.xlsx (MOP answers — placeholder, final to follow).

Happy to jump on a quick bridge if that helps get procurement moving.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Priya Sharma <priya@starlight.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Alex Wong <awong@starlight.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlight — leadership recap & decision anchors (procurement + escalation checklist)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the concise summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The SOC2 evidence is critical; can you confirm you can provide SOC2 Type II evidence and a data-retention policy summary in the packet you send?
- For budget, finance wants a line-item estimate showing reserved capacity vs on-demand token spend for the pilot (we need to show cost delta).
- Procurement: Marty Lopez is the procurement lead (marty.lopez@starlight.io). He’s out Monday morning but available Tue afternoon.

Can you also call out the rollback/fail-safe plan if latency or quality regressions occur during the pilot? That will reduce procurement friction.

Priya
Head of Product, Starlight Media
priya@starlight.io

>

> [snip — full summary above]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Starlight — leadership recap & decision anchors (procurement + escalation checklist)

Jonas / Marissa —

Good capture, Jonas. Two tactical asks from my side before we send the next packet: 

1) Pricing lane split: create a one-page table that shows (A) 3-month reserved pilot price (committed tokens) + optional credit, (B) pure on-demand estimate at current expected volumes, and (C) delta in $ and % so their CFO can sign off quickly. I can help with numbers if you send expected volumes.

2) Risk & rollback plan: include an ops section that lists the fallback model variant, rollback SLA (e.g., 15-min fallback to a lower-cost variant), and telemetry hooks we’ll ship (tracing + per-request ids). Procurement likes concrete SLO language.

I recommend we offer a small trial credit (one-week buffer) as a deal sweetener if Finance remains hesitant — we can gate to launch metrics. If procurement presses on data residency, escalate to Private deployment (we can start with a VPC pilot).

I’ll draft the pricing lane and the ops rollback language by Monday AM. Jonas — can you confirm whether we have any standard 30/60/90 pilot credit language legal is comfortable with? If not, I’ll pull Marissa in.

Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@starlight.io>, Alex Wong <awong@starlight.io>, Marty Lopez <marty.lopez@starlight.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlight — leadership recap & decision anchors (procurement + escalation checklist)

Priya / Marty / Alex —

Thanks — noted on SOC2 evidence and procurement timeline. I’ve attached the pilot proposal and the MOP answers as promised. Short answers to your asks below: 

- SOC2: We will include a SOC2 Type II attestation summary and a redacted audit scope document in the packet.
- Pricing table: Karthik is preparing the 3-month reserved vs on-demand delta; I’ll include it in the updated SOW by Wednesday.
- Rollback plan: In the ops appendix we’ll list the fallback to a lower-latency variant, a 15-minute manual rollback path, and a tracing tag we’ll require for every pilot request so you can reconcile results.

Immediate next steps (calendar commitments)
- I’ll send the updated SOW + pricing table by Wed EOD (deliverable: SOW v0.2 + pricing table).
- Marty — can you confirm Tue 14:00-15:00 PT for a procurement touchpoint? If that works I’ll add VP of Sales and our legal PD to the invite.

Attachments
- redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf — scope, SOW draft, ops appendix (pilot metrics, rollback path).
- starlight-mop-answers.xlsx — initial MOP responses (answers to your procurement questionnaire).

If procurement needs an exec call we’ll set that up; otherwise we’ll aim to get the SOW signed and the reserved lane purchased so the pilot can start in July.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — talk soon.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
